arxiv:2406.06427.title: Notes on Kalman Filter (KF, EKF, ESKF, IEKF, IESKF)
arxiv:2406.06427.why: Wikipedia's Extended Kalman filter article states the predict and update equations without deriving them, and the EKF sheet said so. Section 4 here linearises f and h by first-order Taylor expansion, defines the Jacobians, and carries the linear model through the Kalman prediction and correction steps.

arxiv:2406.06427#8.title: Notes on Kalman Filter (KF, EKF, ESKF, IEKF, IESKF)
arxiv:2406.06427#8.section: 8.1 Derivation of KF prediction step; 8.2 Derivation of KF update step (ver. 1)
arxiv:2406.06427#8.why: All four acceptance-test readers found the same hole: the prediction covariance F P F^T + Q is derived nowhere. 8.1 derives the prediction integral; 8.2 derives the update by completing the square. 8.3, the update as Gaussian conditioning, is left out: its text stops where the substitution C_xz = P H^T, C_zz = H P H^T + Q begins, and that step is an image (25.png) with no text. All three together are over the 24,000 source budget. Note: Section 8 follows Probabilistic Robotics, where R is process noise and Q measurement noise -- the reverse of section 4 and of robot_localization.
